remarks: Welcome to 141 Grove Street in the heart of Mid City Downtown Stamford, CT! This charming townhome has a unique and desirable living experience with a range of features that are sure to impress. This unit boasts 2 bedrooms with loft and 1 half bath, providing ample space for comfortable living. One of the standout features of this property is its private backyard courtyard, providing a peaceful oasis right at your doorstep. Whether you want to enjoy some outdoor relaxation or host a small gathering with friends, this private courtyard is perfect for creating wonderful memories. Additionally, the property comes with underground assigned parking for one car, ensuring your vehicle stays secure and protected from the elements. Furthermore, a visitor parking spot is also provided, allowing your guests to visit without any parking hassles. The property has ample room for all your belongings. The convenience of having your washer and dryer means no more trips to the laundromat. Doing laundry will be a breeze! Schedule a viewing today and see for yourself why this property is a wonderful place!
